en.ammaar-muslim: 4. [4/341] al-Tawhid: Ibn al-Walid from al-Saffar from al-Yaqtini from Yunus who said:
I said to Abi al-Hasan al-Ridha عليه السلام: We have narrated that Allah is Knowledge with no ignorance in Him. Life with no death in Him. Light with no darkness in Him. He said: That is who He is.
